description: This Java class, `IntelliJ`, generates IntelliJ IDE project configuration files (like .ipr and .iml files) from a given project configuration, including source roots, exclusions, and jar dependencies.

classes.name: IntelliJ
classes.description: Utility class responsible for generating IntelliJ project configuration files based on a provided project configuration.

methods.name: generateFrom
methods.description: Generates IntelliJ project files (`.ipr`, `.iml`) from the supplied `Configuration` object, including source directories, exclusions, and dependencies.

methods.name: isTests
methods.description: Determines if a given source directory path should be marked as a test source based on its path content.
